Docs.summary: Calculates the eight-byte CRC-64 defined in ECMA-182, Annex B.
Docs.remarks: Byte results use big-endian order. CRC-64 has incompatible variants; this implementation does not use the CRC defined by ISO 3309. If this implementation's CRC bytes follow the original message, the CRC of the combined input is eight zero bytes.
